snapshot.title: Kiln
snapshot.description:
Kiln itself: an agentic collaboration tool where one user and several AI agents plan and track Projects → Features → Tasks, stored as committed text files under `.kiln/`. `Requirements.md` is the authoritative spec.

Already built (steps 1–2 of the build order): the data model and `.kiln/` file store, the service layer, the MCP server, the Connect API and `kiln serve`.
